issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared across all saloon instances), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method. This mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about whether the method should be static and may lead to inconsistent implementations or grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and implementation consistent. Either (A) update the solution to declare calculateTotalPrice as static (public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) so it matches the problem statement, or (B) update the problem statement to not require calculateTotalPrice to be static. If making the method static, ensure any calls in examples/tests are compatible (calling via class name SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) or allow instance calls, noting Java permits calling static methods via instances though class-qualified calls are preferred).
